articles.summary: LONDON, Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Navigator Holdings Ltd. (described herein as “Navigator Gas” or the “Company”) (NYSE: NVGS), the owner and operator of the world’s largest fleet of handysize liquefied gas carriers, announces today its results for the three months ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter Financial Highlights • For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, pursuant to the Company's capital return policy (the "Capital Return Policy") the Board of Directors of the Company declared, on November 3, 2026, a cash dividend of $0.08 per share of the Company's common stock, payable on December 3, 2026, to all shareholders of record as of the close of business U.S. Eastern Time on November 17, 2026 (the “Dividend”). articles.summary: LONDON, Nov. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Navigator Holdings Ltd. (described herein as “ Navigator Gas ” or the “ Company ”) (NYSE: NVGS) announced today that, in connection with its previously announced change in corporate domicile from the Marshall Islands to England and Wales, it is making available to its shareholders the independent accountants’ report prepared by Grant Thornton UK Advisory Tax LLP (“ Grant Thornton ”) as required under section 593(1) of the UK Companies Act 2006 (the “ Report ”).
